meta.title: agentsys
meta.description: A modular runtime and orchestration system for AI agents. 11 plugins, 5 agents, 14 skills - structured pipelines for Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex CLI, Cursor, and Kiro.
meta.author: Avi Fenesh

hero.title: A modular runtime and orchestration system for AI agents
hero.subtitle: AI models can write code. That's not the hard part anymore. The hard part is everything around it - branch management, code review, artifact cleanup, CI. AgentSys is the runtime that orchestrates agents to handle all of it.

problem.title: The bottleneck isn't code generation
problem.description: Frontier models write good code. That's solved. What's not solved is context management, compaction amnesia, task drift, skipped steps, token waste, babysitting, and repetitive requests. You shouldn't have to orchestrate each phase manually, every single session.
points: Context management - models forget what they're doing mid-session
Compaction amnesia - long sessions get summarized, losing critical state
Task drift - without structure, agents wander from the actual goal
Skipped steps - agents skip reviews, tests, or cleanup when not enforced
Token waste - using LLM calls for work that static analysis can do faster
Babysitting - manually orchestrating each phase of development
Repetitive requests - asking for the same workflow every single session

approach.title: Code does code work. AI does AI work.
approach.description: Detection uses regex, AST analysis, and static analysis - fast, deterministic, no tokens wasted. Judgment uses LLM calls for synthesis, planning, and review - where reasoning matters.

commands.name: /foreman
commands.tagline: GitHub issues as a task queue
commands.description: Works a repo's open issues as a queue for one session and its worktree subagents: pick the next ready issue, claim it, brief a worker, read Revuto's findings and land the PR at the exact head it checked, through the repo's own land command. GitHub labels and comments are the only state, read live.

commands.name: /banthis
commands.description: Capture repeated agent mistakes as managed banned-behavior rules in CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md. Includes a tiny CLI, skill, slash command, and init meta-rule.

commands.name: /agnix
commands.tagline: Lint agent configs before they break
commands.description: 457 validation rules for Skills, Memory, Hooks, MCP, and Plugins across 10+ AI tools including Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Cline, Windsurf, Roo Code, and Amp. SARIF output for GitHub Code Scanning.

commands.name: /deslop
commands.tagline: Kill AI slop before it ships
commands.description: 3-phase detection pipeline finds debug statements, placeholder text, verbose comments, TODOs, and over-engineering patterns. Certainty-graded findings across JS/TS, Python, Rust, Go, Java.

commands.name: /learn
commands.tagline: Research any topic, build a learning guide
commands.description: Progressive discovery gathers 10-40 online sources, scores them by quality, and synthesizes a structured guide with RAG index. Creates reusable knowledge in agent-knowledge/.

commands.name: /skillers
commands.description: Reads Claude Code conversation transcripts, identifies recurring patterns, clusters them into weighted themes, and suggests skills, hooks, or agents to automate them. No per-turn overhead.

commands.name: /skill-curator
commands.description: Create and improve cross-tool skills with strong activation triggers, tight scope, router patterns, Skip unless gates, and agnix-ready structure.

commands.name: /system-prompt-curator
commands.description: Create and improve system prompts with task-matched identity, phased workflows, explicit tools, evidence-based completion criteria, and error recovery examples.

philosophy.title: One agent, one job, done extremely well
philosophy.description: Same principle as good code: single responsibility. The deslop-agent cleans. The learn-agent researches. Specialized agents with narrow scope and clear success criteria.

philosophy.title: Pipeline with gates, not a monolith
philosophy.description: Same principle as DevOps. Each step must pass before the next begins. Can't push before review. Can't merge before CI passes. Hooks enforce this - agents cannot skip phases.

philosophy.title: Tools do tool work, agents do agent work
philosophy.description: If static analysis, regex, or a shell command can do it, don't ask an LLM. Pattern detection uses pre-indexed regex. File discovery uses glob. The LLM only handles what requires judgment.

philosophy.title: Right model for the task
philosophy.description: Opus for complex reasoning and analysis. Sonnet for pattern matching and validation. Quality compounds - early phases deserve the best model.

philosophy.title: Validate plan and results, not every step
philosophy.description: Approve the plan. See the results. The middle is automated. /foreman picks the issue, briefs the worker, reads the review and lands the PR without a prompt at each step.

philosophy.title: Composable, not monolithic
philosophy.description: Every command works standalone. /deslop cleans code without /foreman. /foreman works the issue queue without any other plugin. Pieces compose together, but each piece is useful on its own.
